rationale: The recent equity offering news ($325M) creates a classic dilution overhang that typically pressures share price, yet the stock is currently trading at the top of today's range (100th percentile) and above prior close, suggesting the market has partially absorbed or is ignoring the dilution. The bid-ask spread of 79.3 bps on a thinly-floated, low-volume utility name (65K shares traded) makes the cost of entry prohibitive for intraday scalping, and the single 1-minute candle available provides insufficient price action structure to establish a directional thesis with confidence. With SPY down 1.09% and volatility elevated, the risk/reward does not justify committing capital here.
